facts.fact: Snowflake's Modern Marketing Data Stack 2023 report identified ten technology categories that organizations consider when building their marketing data stacks.
facts.quote: Snowflake identified ten technology categories that organizations consider when building their marketing data stacks.

facts.fact: StackAdapt was named a leader in the Advertising Platforms category of Snowflake's Modern Marketing Data Stack 2023 report, per the press release dated September 14, 2023.
facts.quote: today announced that it has been recognized as an Advertising Platforms leader in the Modern Marketing Data Stack 2023

facts.fact: The report included only companies that are active members of the Snowflake Partner Network (or have a comparable agreement with Snowflake) and Snowflake Marketplace providers.
facts.quote: Focusing on those companies that are active members of the Snowflake Partner Network (or ones with a comparable agreement in place with Snowflake), as well as Snowflake Marketplace providers

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
